name: BABY SLIME
advantage: Baby Slime gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Baby Slime is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] BABY SLIME was the first creature to gather around the fallen blue spark. It was not guarding the light; it was keeping it warm until someone brave enough arrived.

name: MEADOW MOTH
advantage: Meadow Moth gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Meadow Moth is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] MEADOW MOTH carried pollen from every flower touched by the spark. Each glowing trail led to a missing villager's doorstep, as if the moth remembered people the village had forgotten.

name: DEWDROP SPRITE
advantage: Dewdrop Sprite gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Dewdrop Sprite is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] DEWDROP SPRITE heard the old lullaby inside the spark and began singing it at dusk. The tune made the meadow bloom, but one verse always ended in a child's frightened cry.

name: MOSSLING
advantage: Mossling gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Mossling is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] MOSSLING rang a cracked bell whenever the corruption crept closer. Its tiny hands shook with every strike, yet it never stopped warning the sleeping village.

name: PEBBLE TOAD
advantage: Pebble Toad gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Pebble Toad is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] PEBBLE TOAD guarded the stream where the blue spark first landed. Beneath its stones lay a map of roots, all pointing toward a sealed chamber under the oldest tree.

name: BRAMBLE FOX
advantage: Bramble Fox gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Bramble Fox is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] BRAMBLE FOX stood between the corruption and a nest of orphaned birds. It fought like a monster, but every wound it took was meant for something smaller.

name: GLOWCAP MUSHROOM
advantage: Glowcap Mushroom gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Glowcap Mushroom is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] GLOWCAP MUSHROOM lit a hidden path with spores that formed the names of the missing. One name appeared brighter than the rest: the name carved into the first seal.

name: BARK BEETLE
advantage: Bark Beetle gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Bark Beetle is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] BARK BEETLE carried a black thread embedded beneath its shell. When the thread tugged north, the beetle resisted, because it knew the thread was leading the darkness toward the village.

name: WHISPER WOLF
advantage: Whisper Wolf gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Whisper Wolf is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] WHISPER WOLF was once the meadow's guardian. The corruption stole its voice, but not its memory; it begged you silently to save the creatures still trapped beyond the roots.

name: Stone Golem
advantage: Stone Golem gains an edge in Whispering Meadow terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Stone Golem is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [1/10 · Whispering Meadow] STONE GOLEM rose from beneath the oldest tree as the first seal's keeper. It recognized the blue spark as the key, then challenged you because the seal would open only for someone willing to protect the meadow.

name: DUST SCORPION
advantage: Dust Scorpion gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Dust Scorpion is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] DUST SCORPION dragged a silver canteen across the dunes, leaving a trail toward the riverbed that vanished the night the first seal awakened. Its pincers were stained blue from trying to dig the water back out.

name: DUNE STALKER
advantage: Dune Stalker gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Dune Stalker is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] DUNE STALKER had followed a child's wooden sun across the desert for seven years. The child was one of the missing villagers, and the toy was warm whenever the buried river stirred beneath the sand.

name: GLASSWING VIPER
advantage: Glasswing Viper gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Glasswing Viper is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] GLASSWING VIPER saw the desert's hidden waterways reflected in its transparent wings. It attacked anyone who followed the map because the river did not lead to an oasis; it led to a door beneath the dunes.

name: SAND WRAITH
advantage: Sand Wraith gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Sand Wraith is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] SAND WRAITH guarded the last underground well, where the missing villagers' memories drifted like pale fish. It had forgotten its own face, but remembered every name it had sworn to protect.

name: CANYON BRUTE
advantage: Canyon Brute gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Canyon Brute is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] CANYON BRUTE heard a voice from the sealed tomb calling it by a name older than the desert. Each time it answered, the canyon walls cracked, revealing murals of the blue spark being carried from the meadow.

name: SUNSCALE LIZARD
advantage: Sunscale Lizard gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Sunscale Lizard is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] SUNSCALE LIZARD warmed the stone tablets at the edge of the buried river. As the writing appeared, the lizard showed you the truth: the second seal was built to imprison a creature that drank memories to keep the world asleep.

name: MIRAGE DJINN
advantage: Mirage Djinn gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Mirage Djinn is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] MIRAGE DJINN offered to restore the villagers' stolen memories, but demanded the memory of your first victory in return. It was not cruel; it had made the same bargain long ago and could no longer remember whom it had saved.

name: BURIED SENTINEL
advantage: Buried Sentinel gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Buried Sentinel is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] BURIED SENTINEL broke its stone silence when the well began to run black. Its ancient command was simple: keep the tomb closed, even if every living soul outside forgot why it mattered.

name: MINOTAUR WARDEN
advantage: Minotaur Warden gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Minotaur Warden is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] MINOTAUR WARDEN tore free of the chains binding it to the tomb entrance. It begged you not to mistake its prison guard's duty for loyalty to the thing below; it had stayed for centuries so the forgotten villagers could keep their names.

name: Ancient Minotaur
advantage: Ancient Minotaur gains an edge in Ashen Desert terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Ancient Minotaur is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Storm-aligned attacks.
story: [2/10 · Ashen Desert] Ancient Minotaur emerged from the tomb with the stolen memories circling its horns like a crown. When you defeated it, the second seal opened, and the creature beneath the desert whispered your name in a voice that sounded exactly like the first blue spark.

name: STORM HARPY
advantage: Storm Harpy gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Storm Harpy is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] STORM HARPY circles the ridge where the desert's second seal sent a blue pulse into the clouds. Its wings are torn because it has spent a century keeping lightning away from a nest of orphaned sky-chicks. Tonight, the storm answers a voice rising from beneath the mountains.

name: VOLT HOUND
advantage: Volt Hound gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Volt Hound is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] VOLT HOUND follows you through the glass-grass, carrying a cracked collar engraved with a child's name recovered from the Ashen Desert memories. It mistakes your shadow for its missing companion, but when the thunder speaks, the little hound stands between you and the sound.

name: CLOUD SERPENT
advantage: Cloud Serpent gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Cloud Serpent is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] CLOUD SERPENT coils around an invisible tower above the cliffs. Inside its scales you glimpse the missing villagers walking through a sky that has no sun. The serpent guards the tower because its bell is the only thing keeping the third seal from opening too soon.

name: TEMPEST WISP
advantage: Tempest Wisp gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Tempest Wisp is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] TEMPEST WISP slips from the tower carrying a feather of living lightning. It shows you a message left by the Minotaur Warden: the second seal did not imprison the storm; it warned the world that something below was learning to call the sky by name.

name: SKYBREAKER ROC
advantage: Skybreaker Roc gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Skybreaker Roc is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] SKYBREAKER ROC dives through the storm and shatters the tower's outer rings. Each fragment shows a different memory of the first blue spark, including one in which the spark was not falling from heaven but escaping from a cage beneath the world.

name: LIGHTNING OGRE
advantage: Lightning Ogre gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Lightning Ogre is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] LIGHTNING OGRE stands guard at a bridge of black glass, refusing to attack until the thunder stops calling it by the name of its dead daughter. When you quiet the voice, it gives you the bridge key and warns that the storm is being fed by a heartbeat under the mountain.

name: STORMCALLER WITCH
advantage: Stormcaller Witch gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Stormcaller Witch is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] STORMCALLER WITCH has been gathering the final words of the lost sky-guardians, hoping to weave them into a warning strong enough to reach the sealed heart below. She reveals that the third seal is cracking from the inside, not from your victories.

name: THUNDER COLOSSUS
advantage: Thunder Colossus gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Thunder Colossus is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] THUNDER COLOSSUS wakes beneath the black-glass bridge, its chest full of trapped thunder and the names stolen from the desert. It fights because the voice below has promised to return every lost memory if the colossus breaks the last chain. You hear the same voice that spoke after the second seal opened.

name: STORM WYRM
advantage: Storm Wyrm gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Storm Wyrm is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] STORM WYRM guards the final ascent, its horns pierced by fragments of the third seal. When it falls, the clouds part and reveal a second moon beneath the world: a vast eye looking upward. The Wyrm's last breath tells you the Thunder Dragon is not the jailer, but the lock.

name: Thunder Dragon
advantage: Thunder Dragon gains an edge in Stormglass Highlands terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Thunder Dragon is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Nature-aligned attacks.
story: [3/10 · Stormglass Highlands] Thunder Dragon descends through the broken sky as the third seal begins to fail. It carries the names and memories recovered from the meadow and desert inside its lightning heart. Defeating it does not destroy the seal; it lets the dragon release its burden and open the way forward. The voice beneath the world finally speaks without disguise: it remembers creating the first blue spark, and it remembers why it was afraid.

name: GRAVE LANTERN
advantage: Grave Lantern gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Grave Lantern is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] GRAVE LANTERN waits at the border of the Hollow Kingdom, where the Thunder Dragon's released memories have become pale lights. One lantern burns blue whenever you pass, showing a child standing beside the first seal and holding the same spark that began your journey.

name: HOLLOW KNIGHT
advantage: Hollow Knight gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Hollow Knight is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] HOLLOW KNIGHT blocks the old royal road, its armor bearing the crest of your village. It remembers escorting the missing child into the kingdom before the seals were built, but its oath forbids it from revealing who ordered the journey.

name: ASHEN BANSHEE
advantage: Ashen Banshee gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Ashen Banshee is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] ASHEN BANSHEE sings the lullaby once heard beside the meadow's cracked bell. Each verse restores a memory to the spirits, and each restored spirit points toward the palace where the fourth seal was forged from the kingdom's own dead.

name: CRYPT SPIDER
advantage: Crypt Spider gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Crypt Spider is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] CRYPT SPIDER has woven a silver tapestry showing your battles in the meadow, desert and highlands. At its center is a scene that has not happened: you standing before a throne while a familiar child asks you to forgive the world.

name: DREAD HOUND
advantage: Dread Hound gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Dread Hound is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] DREAD HOUND guards a doorway beneath the palace and trembles whenever the darkness behind it moves. It recognizes the scent of the Thunder Dragon on you, then lowers its head as if begging you not to mistake the thing beyond the door for another monster.

name: SOUL LEECH
advantage: Soul Leech gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Soul Leech is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] SOUL LEECH feeds on the grief of the kingdom's ghosts, but refuses to consume one memory: the face of the child who once gave it shelter. When you free the memory, it reveals that the fourth seal was built to contain the kingdom's protector after its heart broke.

name: BLACKTHORN REAPER
advantage: Blackthorn Reaper gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Blackthorn Reaper is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] BLACKTHORN REAPER cuts the chains binding the restless dead, one name at a time. It tells you the child in the tapestry was the kingdom's last heir, and that the first blue spark was created to carry the heir's promise beyond the sealed gates.

name: MOONLESS HORROR
advantage: Moonless Horror gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Moonless Horror is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] MOONLESS HORROR tears open its own shadow to show you the truth: the monsters across every world were fleeing the same grief-stricken guardian. The fourth seal does not hold a demon; it holds a protector who begged to be forgotten.

name: SHADOW WYRM
advantage: Shadow Wyrm gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Shadow Wyrm is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] SHADOW WYRM circles the palace roof, wearing the silhouette of the child who vanished before the first seal was made. It gives you the key to the throne room, warning that the guardian will recognize your voice and ask why you took so long.

name: Ancient Shadow Dragon
special_move: Ancient Shadow Dragon's Starfall Worldroot Slam · 40
advantage: Ancient Shadow Dragon gains an edge in Hollow Kingdom terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Ancient Shadow Dragon is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Earth-aligned attacks.
story: [4/10 · Hollow Kingdom] Ancient Shadow Dragon rises from the throne beneath the Hollow Kingdom, carrying the fourth seal in its broken heart. When you defeat it, the dead speak the guardian's true name and the seal opens without erasing them. The child from the tapestry appears in the fading light and tells you the first blue spark was never a weapon: it was a promise that someone would come back.

name: CINDER BEETLE
advantage: Cinder Beetle gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Cinder Beetle is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] CINDER BEETLE crawls from a crack beneath the Hollow Kingdom, carrying a coal that burns with the same gentle blue as the first spark. It is not feeding the volcano; it is keeping a tiny nest warm for the fire-creatures fleeing the mountain's heart.

name: MAGMA SERPENT
advantage: Magma Serpent gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Magma Serpent is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] MAGMA SERPENT coils around a bridge above the lava, shielding the only safe path from the eruption. It recognizes the fourth seal's mark on your gear and asks whether the dead of the Hollow Kingdom finally found peace.

name: ASHEN BRUTE
advantage: Ashen Brute gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Ashen Brute is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] ASHEN BRUTE carries a melted crown, the last gift from a queen who ordered her people to flee before the Ember Abyss awakened. The crown's underside bears the same promise as the blue spark: someone must remember those who stayed behind.

name: FLAME REVENANT
advantage: Flame Revenant gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Flame Revenant is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] FLAME REVENANT rises from the queen's abandoned forge and bows when it sees the blue spark. It reveals that the fifth seal was forged here, using the warmth of a living heart rather than stone or metal.

name: LAVA WARDEN
advantage: Lava Warden gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Lava Warden is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] LAVA WARDEN has guarded the furnace gate for centuries, holding shut a sleeping fire that once protected the world from the cold beyond it. It warns that the seal is weakening because the guardian inside has begun to dream again.

name: INFERNO WITCH
advantage: Inferno Witch gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Inferno Witch is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] INFERNO WITCH offers to quiet the volcano, but asks for the memory of your first victory. She admits she has already traded away her own past to keep the fifth seal stable, and now remembers only the sound of someone calling her mother.

name: OBSIDIAN BEHEMOTH
advantage: Obsidian Behemoth gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Obsidian Behemoth is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] OBSIDIAN BEHEMOTH is built from the broken armor of guardians who tried to hold the furnace gate. Their memories speak through its stone plates, revealing that the child from the Hollow Kingdom was not the only one who made a promise to the sealed heart.

name: CALDERA TYRANT
advantage: Caldera Tyrant gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Caldera Tyrant is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] CALDERA TYRANT rules the burning terraces and believes the world must be destroyed before the thing beneath it can suffer again. It shows you visions of the five seals as one great lock around the world's heart, each forged to protect the same wounded being.

name: OBSIDIAN TITAN
advantage: Obsidian Titan gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Obsidian Titan is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] OBSIDIAN TITAN stands before the furnace core, its body split by glowing lines shaped like the first blue spark. It tells you the fifth seal is not a prison door but a heartbeat regulator, and that breaking it carelessly could end every world you have saved.

name: World Destroyer Titan
special_move: World Destroyer Titan's Starfall Worldroot Slam · 50
advantage: World Destroyer Titan gains an edge in Ember Abyss terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: World Destroyer Titan is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Astral-aligned attacks.
story: [5/10 · Ember Abyss] World Destroyer Titan awakens inside the furnace, carrying the fifth seal in its molten chest. When you defeat it, the fire does not consume the world; it becomes a bridge of warmth through which the sealed heart sends a memory. The voice calls you by the forgotten name of the child who first carried the blue spark, then begs you to find the remaining seals before its heartbeat stops.

name: ICEBOUND STAG
advantage: Icebound Stag gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Icebound Stag is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] ICEBOUND STAG guides the refugees from the Ember Abyss through a blizzard that falls upward. Its antlers hold tiny blue flames, each one a memory rescued from the fifth seal before the furnace went dark.

name: SNOW WRAITH
advantage: Snow Wraith gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Snow Wraith is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] SNOW WRAITH carries a frozen flower inside its chest, the last bloom from the kingdom buried beneath these peaks. It offers the flower to you when it recognizes the warmth left by the fifth seal, then warns that the sixth seal is freezing from the inside.

name: GLACIER TROLL
advantage: Glacier Troll gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Glacier Troll is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] GLACIER TROLL blocks a narrow pass with a wall of ice, not to trap travelers but to shield them from the white storm beyond. Scratched into the wall are the names of the guardians who helped forge the first five seals.

name: RIMEFANG
advantage: Rimefang gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Rimefang is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] RIMEFANG sings the winter song of a kingdom erased by the thaw. The melody reveals that the sixth seal was made to preserve a memory, not a monster: the moment the world's wounded guardian first chose mercy over destruction.

name: WHITEOUT HARPY
advantage: Whiteout Harpy gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Whiteout Harpy is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] WHITEOUT HARPY guards a nest whose eggs will hatch only when the sky is healed. It shows you a vision of the first blue spark crossing the heavens, pursued by a shadow that looks like your own silhouette.

name: FROST REVENANT
advantage: Frost Revenant gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Frost Revenant is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] FROST REVENANT remembers the face of the smith who sealed the mountain gates. The smith was the child from the Hollow Kingdom, grown old and afraid that opening the sixth seal would awaken the grief beneath the ice.

name: PERMAFROST GIANT
advantage: Permafrost Giant gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Permafrost Giant is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] PERMAFROST GIANT holds the mountain gate shut with chains frozen into its own body. It asks you to free it only after you have learned why the first five guardians chose to protect the same hidden heart.

name: WINTER'S MAW
advantage: Winter'S Maw gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Winter'S Maw is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] WINTER'S MAW carries an avalanche on its back, keeping the snow from burying the last village. Beneath its frozen armor you hear the sixth seal beating in time with your own heart, and understand that the seal is reacting to you.

name: ASTRAL WYRM
advantage: Astral Wyrm gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Astral Wyrm is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] ASTRAL WYRM guards the stairway to the frozen observatory, where every star reflects a memory from the worlds you have crossed. It reveals that the sixth seal can open only when its guardian is remembered by name, not defeated in anger.

name: Celestial Dragon God
special_move: Celestial Dragon God's Starfall Worldroot Slam · 60
advantage: Celestial Dragon God gains an edge in Frostfang Peaks terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Celestial Dragon God is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Water-aligned attacks.
story: [6/10 · Frostfang Peaks] Celestial Dragon God descends above the frozen observatory, carrying the sixth seal as a crown of living ice. When you defeat it, the crown melts into six streams of light and restores the memories of the mountain guardians. A voice beneath the ice speaks the name of the world's wounded protector, then warns that the seventh seal is hidden where the dead stars fall.

name: RIFT STALKER
advantage: Rift Stalker gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Rift Stalker is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] RIFT STALKER slips between the impact craters, leaving footprints that become constellations. It shows you a star map marking the first six guardians and a seventh point pulsing like a wound.

name: ABYSSAL HOUND
advantage: Abyssal Hound gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Abyssal Hound is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] ABYSSAL HOUND hunts the echoes around the shattered observatory, carrying a fragment of the sixth seal in its jaws. It refuses to surrender the shard until you promise to protect the lost memories sleeping inside it.

name: NULL SIREN
advantage: Null Siren gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Null Siren is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] NULL SIREN sings beneath a meteor shower, catching falling memories in the notes of its song. One memory shows the world's protector asking the child from the Hollow Kingdom to hide the seventh seal beyond the reach of time.

name: STARVED HORROR
advantage: Starved Horror gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Starved Horror is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] STARVED HORROR circles the shattered observatory and steals only the shadows of those who enter. Inside, you discover that the dead stars are fragments of the sky sacrificed to keep the seventh seal hidden.

name: ECLIPSE KNIGHT
advantage: Eclipse Knight gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Eclipse Knight is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] ECLIPSE KNIGHT rises from a crater containing a familiar blue spark. It remembers being built by the first guardians, and its stone heart opens to reveal a message: the seventh seal can be found only by following a star that refuses to fall.

name: VOID DEVOURER
advantage: Void Devourer gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Void Devourer is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] VOID DEVOURER consumes constellations to stop the sky from revealing the hidden seal. It attacks because the guardian beneath the world once commanded it to erase every path that might lead you there.

name: RIFT COLOSSUS
advantage: Rift Colossus gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Rift Colossus is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
story: [7/10 · Starfall Expanse] RIFT COLOSSUS drifts through the ruins with the face of the child who carried the first spark reflected in its armor. It tells you the guardian has begun to remember every life lost while the seals held, and that memory is turning its sorrow into a storm.

name: ABYSS MONARCH
advantage: Abyss Monarch gains an edge in Primordial Rift terrain and against unprepared foes.
disadvantage: Abyss Monarch is vulnerable to disciplined counters and Fire-aligned attacks.
